not_certified: Relevant declared-parameter RFC sections downloaded/read/hash manifest; full normative errata/security/implementation conformance and runtime codecs not certified.

RFC1700 TTL64 is a historical suggested proposal only, not a universal current required value. IPv6 Ethernet1500 applies only to that selected bearer; link/path MTU1280 is a lower constraint rather than a proposed measured path.

Declared upper profile validation remains separate from configured lower layers. New stack_parameter_completeness and unverified_stack_layers explicitly report a conventional but unconfigured IP layer; all capacity/preflight consumers still require full path integration before delivery.

Actual address scope/subnet/neighbor/multicast group validity, exact option/extension/fragment coverage, reassembly buffer, ICMP/PMTU probes, complete IPv4/IPv6 codecs and identity encoding remain unverified.

Generic catalog overhead8/identity transport encoder must not be interpreted as IP header/wire arithmetic; actual headers are independently specified and MODEL_MISSING prevents a certified capacity claim.
No global packet65535 or IPv6 own header checksum; application transport, lower PHY/queues/tunnels, functional E2E/trace/safety remain separate evidence requirements. Production not delivered
